verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference is a fair ask for a registry and gateway platform like Glama, so the axis applies. The evidence mentions a reference page for searching the catalog and keeping a directory synchronized, but nothing shows it is interactive or has runnable examples. Probes for an OpenAPI or Swagger spec all returned 404. The browser-based MCP Inspector tests third-party MCP servers rather than serving as an interactive reference for Glama's own API, so it does not deliver this story.
